L1393:   * 1. What voltage rating, current capacity, and wire gauge ranges govern the JST XHP-2 housing?
L1394: The JST XHP-2 wire-to-board socket housing is rated for a maximum voltage of 250V AC/DC and a continuous current capacity of up to 3A AC/DC when used with AWG #22 conductors. It accepts compatible crimp socket contacts, including the SXH-001T-P0.6 and SXH-002T-P0.6 series, supporting wire sizes from AWG #30 to #22 (0.05–0.33 mm², depending on contact type) with insulation outer diameters ranging from 0.9 mm to 1.9 mm.
